method.selection: Minimum observed cost meeting all category outcome quantiles; linear population scaling.
method.scope: Ten disjoint COFOG categories, all levels of government; 30 European countries.
assumptions: Reference systems can be transferred and combined.
method.outcomeInterpretation: Observed reference outcomes, not predicted combined gains. HALE is a population average, not median healthspan.
method.ranges: Up to three cheapest qualifying alternatives per category; not confidence intervals.

educationSource.note: 2018 share reaching at least PISA mathematics Level 2: 100 minus low-achiever percentage.
